scope: historical exported file; no fresh generation, subjective listening, or browser recording

thresholds.pixelValueSpace: Native decoded 8-bit YUV420p planes; no resize or range-normalization. Y/U/V each 0–255; thresholds cover both nominal video-range black/white and full-range extremes.

nearUniformColour.planeRule: Maximum fraction contained in any 5 consecutive code values
nearUniformColour.interpretation: Candidate flat-colour/blank frame; not semantic content certification.

briefLuminancePulse.interpretation: Only a conservative strong 1–3-frame global luminance pulse detector, not all flicker.
